title: Precision: fp32, fp16, bf16, fp8
hook: Where rounding bites: small LoRA deltas vanish, sums stall, and fp16 overflows at 65,504.

verified.claim: The format limits come from torch.finfo.
--fp8_e4m3fn-unet's help text says Store, and --fp16-vae's says might cause black images.
UNETLoader's weight_dtype menu has those four values.
fp16 overflow to inf, then NaN on normalising, was shown in torch here.
b_unet_fp8 passes validate_prompt with its file menus skipped.

unchecked: We did not render with fp8 weights for this lesson. Whether it is visible on a given model is an empirical question, as the lesson says.
The fp8 rounding in the lab is a hand-written function, from the format's definition. Torch has no compute type for it here.
Whether a LoRA looks weak on an fp8 model is a thing to test. We have not measured it, and the line in What goes wrong is reasoning from experiment 1.
